description: This file defines abstract base classes and interfaces for Spark data sources, including reading, writing, streaming, filter pushdown, and registration mechanisms. It also includes utility classes like filters, input partitions, and case-insensitive options.

classes.name: DataSource
classes.description: Abstract base class for defining custom data sources with methods for schema, reading, writing, and streaming.

classes.name: DataSourceReader
classes.description: Base class for data source readers responsible for outputting data from a data source.

classes.name: DataSourceStreamReader
classes.description: Base class for streaming data source readers responsible for outputting streaming data.

classes.name: SimpleDataSourceStreamReader
classes.description: Simplified streaming data source reader that reads records in the driver node, suitable for lightweight use cases.

classes.name: DataSourceWriter
classes.description: Base class for data source writers responsible for saving data to the data source.

classes.name: DataSourceArrowWriter
classes.description: Base class for data source writers that process data using PyArrow's RecordBatch.

classes.name: DataSourceStreamWriter
classes.description: Base class for streaming data source writers responsible for writing streaming data.

classes.name: DataSourceStreamArrowWriter
classes.description: Base class for streaming data source writers that process data using PyArrow's RecordBatch.

classes.name: WriterCommitMessage
classes.description: Class representing a commit message returned by write methods, must be serializable and picklable.

classes.name: DataSourceRegistration
classes.description: Wrapper class for registering user-defined Python data sources with Spark.

classes.name: InputPartition
classes.description: Represents a data partition used during reading, must be picklable.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Base class for filter pushdown predicates, with subclasses for specific filter types.

classes.name: EqualTo
classes.description: Filter for attribute equal to a specific value.

classes.name: EqualNullSafe
classes.description: Filter for attribute equal to a value, treating NULLs as equal.

classes.name: GreaterThan
classes.description: Filter for attribute greater than a value.

classes.name: GreaterThanOrEqual
classes.description: Filter for attribute greater than or equal to a value.

classes.name: LessThan
classes.description: Filter for attribute less than a value.

classes.name: LessThanOrEqual
classes.description: Filter for attribute less than or equal to a value.

classes.name: In
classes.description: Filter for attribute in a set of values.

classes.name: IsNull
classes.description: Filter for attribute being null.

classes.name: IsNotNull
classes.description: Filter for attribute being not null.

classes.name: Not
classes.description: Negation filter for another filter.

classes.name: StringStartsWith
classes.description: Filter for string attribute starting with a value.

classes.name: StringEndsWith
classes.description: Filter for string attribute ending with a value.

classes.name: StringContains
classes.description: Filter for string attribute containing a substring.

classes.name: CaseInsensitiveDict
classes.description: Dictionary subclass for case-insensitive string keys, used for options.

methods.name: DataSource.schema
methods.description: Method to return the schema of the data source, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: DataSource.reader
methods.description: Method to return a DataSourceReader for reading data, must be implemented.

methods.name: DataSource.writer
methods.description: Method to return a DataSourceWriter for writing data, must be implemented.

methods.name: DataSource.streamWriter
methods.description: Method to return a DataSourceStreamWriter for streaming writes, must be implemented.

methods.name: DataSource.simpleStreamReader
methods.description: Method to return a SimpleDataSourceStreamReader for streaming reads, must be implemented.

methods.name: DataSource.streamReader
methods.description: Method to return a DataSourceStreamReader for streaming reads, must be implemented.

methods.name: DataSourceRegistration.register
methods.description: Registers a user-defined Python data source class with Spark.

methods.name: CaseInsensitiveDict.__setitem__
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with case-insensitive key.

methods.name: CaseInsensitiveDict.__getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves a value with case-insensitive key.

methods.name: CaseInsensitiveDict.update
methods.description: Updates the dictionary with multiple key-value pairs, case-insensitive keys.
